source: User-directed self-improvement/value-transfer recursion, executable dual-dividend membrane, GitHub self-application, convergence tests, and protected-authority self-audit
thesis: The prior methodology knew that repeated useful transformations should crystallize, but it did not explicitly distinguish self-improvement from transferable outward usefulness or give the organism a bounded way to generalize an evidenced internal gain for possible use by another system or person. That gap encouraged either lost reusable value or premature productization. Integrated-v5 adds a dual-dividend membrane: first prove the internal gain multidimensionally; then, only when higher-priority terminal work is not displaced, derive at most one transfer hypothesis whose external value remains unverified until independent reality contact.
mutations: multidimensional internal-improvement accounting across energy/resource use, speed, accuracy, and usable complexity capacity
explicit preservation of regressions and tradeoffs instead of collapsing improvement into one vanity score
dual-dividend distinction between internal performance gain and possible outward transferability
bounded TRANSFER pressure that activates only for evidenced internal Pareto improvements when higher-priority autonomous terminal work is absent
generalization of Flower-specific improvements into reusable transformations, beneficiary hypotheses, value measures, delivery forms, falsifiers, and anti-Goodhart risks
cold transfer seeds as optionality rather than automatic products or public promises
strict separation of internal usefulness from external problem reality, external value, demand, ownership, return, or monetization
one-pass convergence so rejected/context-specific transfer ideas do not trigger ceremonial repeated cognition
executable protection of ownership authority and surplus-allocation authority as human-governed domains

dualDividendModule.result: Unit tests verify that internal gains, regressions, shadow-probe readiness, external-value verification, and idempotent transfer-seed reconciliation remain separate states.
dualDividendModule.implication: The organism can preserve multidimensional self-improvement truth without converting a local gain into an external-value claim.

autonomousTransferPressure.result: Flower Kernel CI completed successfully after tests added a verified internal improvement that causes exactly one bounded TRANSFER pressure, derives a hypothesis through a mock reasoner, crystallizes one unverified transfer seed, and then converges away from TRANSFER. A context-specific improvement likewise remains internal and does not repeat cognition.
autonomousTransferPressure.implication: Transfer analysis adds a new decision capability while remaining subordinate, bounded, and fixed-point compatible.

fullKernelRegression.result: Full kernel syntax, Actor configuration, kernel tests, canonical pressure smoke test, and credential-free idempotent human-sleep behavior passed after the transfer machinery and authority protection were installed.
fullKernelRegression.implication: No existing protected decision path or fixed-point behavior was observed to regress in the repository test surface.

selfAudit.finding: The canonical methodology already named ownership and surplus-allocation authority as protected, while the executable mutation guard omitted those domains.
selfAudit.correction: ownership_authority and surplus_allocation_authority were added to executable protected domains with explicit tests preventing self-promotion without human authorization.
selfAudit.implication: The self-improvement mechanism improved its own authority boundary before canonical stabilization.

assessment.why: The mutation adds a previously unavailable decision: whether an evidenced internal improvement contains a reusable transformation worth testing elsewhere. It is gated behind verified internal improvement, cannot displace active autonomous terminal work, consumes at most one bounded reasoner frontier per unassessed gain, preserves context-specific no-transfer outcomes, and cannot promote external value without independent evidence.
assessment.rollback: Revert integrated-v5 methodology plus improvement-transfer pressure/enzyme/reasoner-view wiring and restore integrated-v4 if transfer analysis creates material terminal delay, recurring cognition, seed spam, hidden maintenance obligations, or systematically distracts the organism from higher-value external reality contact.
assessment.falsifier: If independent runs show that transfer analysis usually produces non-actionable generic abstractions, causes meaningful compute/human burden without later decision value, or makes Flower optimize the number of reusable ideas rather than terminal outcomes, narrow or remove the automatic TRANSFER pressure.
assessment.stoppingCondition: Do not add more transfer stages merely for conceptual completeness. The next justified work is measurement: automatically detect and record real internal before/after improvements so the dual-dividend membrane is fed by accountable evidence rather than manually labeled gains.
